comparison_conclusion: No single retained OrthoHMM configuration demonstrates superiority across the complete metric vector over OrthoFinder 3.1.5 full. OrthoHMM has higher OrthoBench F1 and conditional GO/EC/FAS values in several configurations, while OrthoFinder retains stronger QfO reference F1 endpoints and supplementary Three Kingdoms. Do not synthesize a method from per-dataset winners or claim the per-endpoint envelope is an executable configuration.
default_recommendation: Do not promote any tested accuracy policy or private kernel to the parameter defaults. Preserve the published comparison artifacts and existing presets. Canonical collection is a useful opt-in reproducibility control but changes memberships; neither it, path retention nor singleton tie deferral establishes broad accuracy improvement despite passing the development point screen. Adaptive-coverage denominator repair is an intentional correctness change in adaptive mode, not evidence of accuracy gains; fixed-cap benchmark controls bypass that arithmetic. Bipartition support transport remains an opt-in correctness repair with legacy default retained. Original benchmark CPU libraries remain unchanged.
